description:
Planning-only coverage issue for lib/zaq/engine/workflows/actions/refresh_channel_history_membership.ex lines 35 and 50. Exclusive test ownership: test/zaq/engine/workflows/actions/refresh_channel_history_membership_test.exs (edit existing file only). No production or support edits; no test execution in this planning task.

Functional specification and tests to add BEFORE any implementation: (1) Line 35: direct run/2 with a non-map params value (nil) and a valid map context carrying a persisted super-admin actor, and direct run/2 with valid map scope %{transcript_id: Ecto.UUID.generate()} and a non-map context (nil); assert exact {:error, :unauthorized} for each. This exercises both sides of the run/2 map guard, demonstrates malformed invocation fails closed even when actor identity would otherwise be privileged, and ensures no refresh is attempted. Keep this distinct from existing missing/invalid actor cases, which satisfy the map guard. (2) Line 50: create admin = super_admin_fixture(); call run(%{}, %{actor: %{user_id: admin.id}}) and assert exact {:error, :invalid_scope}. Optionally table-drive partial selectors %{person_id: 123}, %{channel_config_id: 456}, and nonpositive pair %{person_id: 0, channel_config_id: 456} to establish the same fallback without duplicating side-effectful fixtures; each must return exact :invalid_scope. At minimum %{} is required to hit line 50. Contrast with current test: both valid positive IDs reach refresh_person/2 and return :invalid_person; combined transcript/person scope hits line 47, not line 50. Do not treat Jido.Exec.run/3 validation rejections as proof of line 35 or 50: validation may reject before run/2.

Fixtures/helpers: reuse Zaq.DataCase async: true and Zaq.AccountsFixtures.super_admin_fixture/0 already imported in this test; no connector, person, transcript, snapshots or router fixture for these early-return paths. Use literal small scope maps so the contract is visible; generate a UUID only for the map-params / non-map-context example. Assertions: exact error atoms; current tests already establish authorized delegation, unauthorized identities and conflicting scope. No mock/Mox or fake: both paths return before ChannelHistoryMembership.refresh/1 or refresh_person/2; do not mock internal modules or blanket-stub NodeRouter. No external calls, async messages, sleeps, app-env mutation, global Mox, shared state or SQL Sandbox child needed; retain async: true and ordinary DataCase ownership. If a future case actually crosses Channels, plan its real boundary separately rather than diluting these guard tests. Property assessment: finite structural guards have targeted examples, not a broad invariant needing a new property; existing connector_action_schema_test.exs already checks typed schema fields, optional scope inputs, and includes a property for required fields elsewhere. No E2E: no new user journey.

Action reuse assessment: not applicable — tests cover existing Zaq.Engine.Workflows.Actions.RefreshChannelHistoryMembership.run/2 without changing any executable operation, contract, permissions, side effects, or exposure; existing Action delegates to ChannelHistoryMembership and remains workflow-compatible but not an agent tool. No added docs or Action/tool/workflow consumer. Validation for the later implementing agent: run the isolated test/zaq/engine/workflows/actions/refresh_channel_history_membership_test.exs via mix test and mix q through Context Mode, inspect the diff and a fresh appropriate coverage report to verify both line hits; follow WORKFLOW_AGENT Phase 6 for the post-review coverage/final precommit gate if applicable. Planning task performs none of these runs. Blockers/unreachable branches: no inherent blocker for direct run/2; through Jido.Exec.run/3 malformed input may be intercepted by schema validation so coverage via Exec alone is not guaranteed. If instrumentation shows line 50 still missed, confirm exact file revision/line mapping and whether an unexpected validation/authorization path short-circuited; do not add test-only production seams. No dependencies; one test surface/one issue.
title: [coverage] Cover RefreshChannelHistoryMembership guard fallbacks
